crossRefs.note: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.
For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck…
He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of…
He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there who had his hand withered.
Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of…
He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
translations.bsb: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
translations.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
translations.asv: Now it was the sabbath on the day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
